title: 12th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/12/3/2025).

Question from Kanditheemu MP Ameen Faisal to the Minister of Economic Development and Trade, Mohamed Saeed: how many foreign vessels has the bunkering service launched in the north served so far, what is the total net income earned, and at the current rate when will the previously estimated USD 400 million be reached?

Question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Economic Development and Trade, Mohamed Saeed: the Hajj Corporation has announced it will enter the tourist hotel business, which private Maldivian businesses already run; did the minister act to stop this, what did he do, and what impact will it have on private hotels and guesthouses?

Preliminary debate on the resolution submitted by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to determine members' view on the government delaying flat handovers to many of the 4,000 beneficiaries of the Gedhoruveriya scheme, leaving reclamation at Gulhifalhu, Giraavarufalhu and Hulhumalé Phase 3 under the first Binveriya scheme unfinished, and ignoring the rights of applicants for Hulhumalé flats and Uthuru Thilafalhu land under the second Gedhoruveriya/Binveriya scheme while prioritising the Ras Malé project, costing thousands of Maldivians their right to housing.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to question the Economic Minister on bunkering revenue and the Hajj Corporation's hotel plans, then open debate on a resolution criticising delays in the government's housing schemes.
